visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an extreme close-up of a pair of hands holding a large, white steamed bun. The bun is pulled apart to reveal a rich filling containing a whole brown braised egg, edamame, and mixed vegetables. The lighting is bright and indoor, highlighting the soft texture of the bread. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a modern, well-lit bakery interior. Several customers with face masks are browsing shelves and standing in line. The background is a mix of warm wood tones and bright white walls, with various products displayed in baskets. (3) A close-up shows hands pulling apart a scallion-filled bun, demonstrating its elastic and fluffy texture. The bright indoor lighting emphasizes the green scallions embedded within the white dough layers. (4) The camera focuses on a shopping basket where a hand places a bun wrapped in clear plastic. The background shows more baskets filled with similar packaged goods in a retail environment. (5) A close-up reveals a steamer tray filled with several types of warm steamed buns, including plain white ones and light brown ones. A pair of metal tongs enters the frame to pick up a bun, showing the steam rising slightly. (6) A staff member in a brown apron holds a plate of small bun samples on toothpicks. A hand reaches in to take one, demonstrating a red bean filling with a yellow center. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (7) The camera captures a close-up of a hand pouring a dark liquid, presumably tea, from a pitcher into a small white paper cup. The cup sits on a counter next to other similar cups in a self-service area. (8) A series of rapid close-ups showcase various buns being torn open to reveal different fillings: green vegetables with tofu, shredded cabbage, a cheesy potato mix, and purple taro paste. Each shot focuses on the tactile nature of the food. (9) The camera shows packaged breads and a pink-wrapped sun cake being held up to the lens. The background is slightly blurred but clearly part of the same store. (10) A static shot of a red digital menu board displays prices for different bun types, followed by a blue and white schedule board indicating when specific flavors are released. (11) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the shop at dusk. The building has a modern grey corrugated metal facade with a large red and yellow sign that reads 'SUNNY STEAMED BUNS' in English and Chinese.
